method.linux: Fresh loopback TCP GET, through last body byte. Health JSON and homepage-linked CSS digest verified.
method.windows: Fresh workstation TCP GET of health JSON through an existing authenticated SSH forward to the same loopback endpoint. Includes network, forward and response bytes, excludes SSH setup.
method.time: Each three-GET row is enclosed by timestamps from the same Linux monotonic clock as the compiler. Fresh jobs only. Idle rows require an unpopulated receiver guest at both ends.
method.percentile: Nearest rank over equal sample counts within each pair, evenly spaced by index. Source-order A/B, B/A, warm-cache, polling pause 200 ms. First/last host counters define each phase window.
method.workload: Four receiver-installed public CPython modules are compiled each round. Four checked-hash pyc files are produced in the isolated job workspace and hash-checked across all jobs.
method.attribution: Block counters cover the host partition and its containing disk; do not add devices. Host page cache/writeback and other services affect these windows. Process write_bytes is kernel accounting within compiler boundaries. An absent cgroup io.stat is null.
method.service_scope: Radar HTTP handling and one static frontend asset. Long-running dashboard operations, external traffic and user-selected production SLO remain unmeasured.
